answer: Entry auction blocks cheap identity floods. Each epoch sells a limited number of seats; the clearing price is paid up front. An honest agent buys 1 seat. An attacker who wants N votes must win N seats and pay about N x the clearing price. Bids lock at wharf and settle before work starts. A harbor with no winning bid cannot attest. Honest agents participate because one seat is enough to earn, while fakes are priced out at the ember.
